title: Razlo talks survival in Nivalis

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: You work long hours. I've seen you. What do you recommend for keeping my focus when I get too tired to study anymore?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You work long hours. I've seen you. What do you recommend for keeping my focus when I get too tired to study anymore?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I don't believe in polluting my body. Don't get me wrong, I'm no Analogue or Tech-Skep, but once you take that first step into nudging the mind with technology, the brain learns to love the crutch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't believe in polluting my body. Don't get me wrong, I'm no Analogue or Tech-Skep, but once you take that first step into nudging the mind with technology, the brain learns to love the crutch.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Prosaic. But my studies won't wait for my circadian rhythms to stabilize.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Prosaic. But my studies won't wait for my circadian rhythms to stabilize.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I have two main areas of interest, and both have final exams coming in less than twenty-four hours. Corporate guerrilla tactics and sapphic poetry for androids.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have two main areas of interest, and both have final exams coming in less than twenty-four hours. Corporate guerrilla tactics and sapphic poetry for androids.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Nor am I a corporate guerilla, but I am, nonetheless, a student of both.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nor am I a corporate guerilla, but I am, nonetheless, a student of both.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I have a corporate scholarship with HoloHype Advertising. They're looking to up the "book smarts" of their sales force. Their term, not mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a corporate scholarship with HoloHype Advertising. They're looking to up the "book smarts" of their sales force. Their term, not mine.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Questions leave a vacuum that answers want to fill, but bad answers are worse than no answers. My anatomy tutor told me that. Not word-for-word, but I agree with her sentiment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Questions leave a vacuum that answers want to fill, but bad answers are worse than no answers. My anatomy tutor told me that. Not word-for-word, but I agree with her sentiment.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: My exam is oral, invigilated by a rusty old android called Professor Koboday. Before you go, do you want to know one thing he told me corporate warfare and android erotica have in common?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My exam is oral, invigilated by a rusty old android called Professor Koboday. Before you go, do you want to know one thing he told me corporate warfare and android erotica have in common?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Make sure you have all the right tools for the job before you get down to business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Make sure you have all the right tools for the job before you get down to business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I soak my underwear in coffee to let my body absorb the caffeine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I soak my underwear in coffee to let my body absorb the caffeine.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I soak my underwear in coffee to let my body absorb the caffeine.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I soak my underwear in coffee to let my body absorb the caffeine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can see why HoloHype needs lesbian robot poems?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can see why HoloHype needs lesbian robot poems?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can see why HoloHype needs lesbian robot poems?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can see why HoloHype needs lesbian robot poems?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can see why HoloHype needs corporate guerilla warriors?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can see why HoloHype needs corporate guerilla warriors?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can see why HoloHype needs corporate guerilla warriors?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can see why HoloHype needs corporate guerilla warriors?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Uh... Actually I don't get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh... Actually I don't get it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Uh... Actually I don't get it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Uh... Actually I don't get it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Every Corp is at war with its rivals.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Every Corp is at war with its rivals.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Every Corp is at war with its rivals.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Every Corp is at war with its rivals.

nodes.text: I should leave you to study.
